title: docs(spec): key the fieldPatches example option by a value crm_account.industry stores
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Woe1WqkwqEbbQEviGw1m5U)_
Fixes #28803

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`fieldPatches` 文档示例里的选项键从 `tech` 改成 `crm_account.industry` 真实存储的值 `technology`(`technology: { label: 'Tech' }`),覆盖 spec 描述、TSDoc、选项列表拒收文案、对象扩展指南和两份未发布的 changeset。
- 为什么改:原示例照抄会在 `os validate` 和安装时被拒(该字段没有 `tech` 这个选项),文档在教一个坏例子;技能包那份已在 #28795 修好,这里补齐其余几份。
- 风险与回滚:纯文案,schema 接受/拒收的结果不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`(三处示例文字)、`content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx`、`content/docs/references/data/object.mdx`(重新生成的参考页)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n "tech: {" -- packages/spec/src content/docs skills .changeset ':!*.test.ts'`,预期没有任何输出。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`: the `fieldPatches` `.describe()` example, the `ObjectExtensionSchema` TSDoc example, and the refusal text for an option list under `options` now read `options: { technology: { label: 'Tech' } }`. `crm_account.industry` (`examples/app-crm/src/objects/account.object.ts`) stores `technology`, `finance`, `healthcare`, `retail`, `other`; `tech` is none of them, so a copy was refused with reason `option`.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx`: the guide's example, same re-key.
- `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx`: re-recorded by `check:generated --fix` (only `check:docs` was stale).
- `.changeset/28565-field-patch-applied.md` and `.changeset/28560-field-patch-slot.md`: both still unreleased (present in `.changeset/` on `main` at 1617b7fb, no Version Packages release has consumed them), so their copies of the example are re-keyed too. The 28560 copy is a fifth copy the card did not list.
- `.changeset/28803-field-patches-example.md`: spec patch.

No forced test edits. Test fixtures that patch `tech` (`field-customization.test.ts`, `field-patches-derived.test.ts`, and the cli / metadata-core / objectql / cloud-connection field-patch tests) build their own objects and do not pin the documented example text, so they stay as they are.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/data` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: Test Files 154 passed (154), Tests 4756 passed, 1 todo; VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && check:generated`: 1 of 14 stale (`check:docs`), fixed with `--fix`, then all up to date.

## Acceptance notes

- Prose only; no consumer package test is owed (no accept/reject result changes).
- **Pending release notes corrected, so `Check Changeset` stays red by design.** This PR edits two changesets it did not add, both still pending (no Version Packages release has consumed them): `.changeset/28565-field-patch-applied.md` (named by the card, its example line) and `.changeset/28560-field-patch-slot.md` (a fifth copy of the same example, not named by the card). In each, only the option key and label inside the code example change, from `tech: { label: 'Technology' }` to `technology: { label: 'Tech' }`; no sentence about behaviour changes. This is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class `check-empty-changeset.mjs` names: the gate stays red, `skip-changeset` is not applied, and the correction needs a written confirmation on this PR. Restoring either file from the base would republish an example that `os validate` refuses.
- Merged `origin/main` at 663b7c08ee with `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` (#28791 had edited `object.zod.ts` and `object-extensions.mdx`); no conflict, and `check:generated` reports all 14 artifacts up to date on the merged head.
